decisions.reason: The mitred handle family is still mentioned on the website, and its market value is unresolved. A handle line in an established range costs little to carry, so keeping the option open is worthwhile.
The multifunctional handle moved up from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment and a favourably resolving option worth carrying further.
Visibility is unchanged and the evidence is weak, but carrying a handle line inside a coordinated range costs little while uncertainty remains. Pruning is plausible but not yet justified.
The FSB 1289 collection won the German Design Award and the iF Design Award and keeps its own page. Its value is realized, so dropping it makes no sense.
